en.title: SSA Launches Online Disability Claims Tools Amid Nationwide Accessibility Push
en.summary: The Social Security Administration has introduced online tools for tracking disability claims and submitting appeals, streamlining access for beneficiaries. Meanwhile, Netflix announced enhanced accessibility features for children's shows, and ITRI partnered with LifeLi to showcase adaptive cycling technology. Local advocacy efforts also gained momentum as a Canton resident urged municipal building improvements and a partnership brought accessibility upgrades to a regional fair.

highlights.title: SSA Adds Online Tools for Disability Claims and Appeals
Netflix Making Kids’ Shows More Accessible - Disability Scoop
ITRI partners with LifeLi to bring barrier-free cycling into the tech hall
Canton woman calls on Canton to make municipal building more accessible

zh-TW.title: 日本擬團體之家總量管制，無障礙政策受矚目
zh-TW.summary: 日本將自明年四月起對身心障礙者團體之家實施總量管制，可能限制可用服務數量。同時，工研院與生命勵合作推出無障礙騎乘設備，Aperia 商場新增餐飲翼館提升坡道與寬闊通道。此外，地方夥伴為博覽會加設無障礙通道及感官友善區，而日本福利服務破產數據引發社會討論。

highlights.title: 日本將對身心障礙者團體之家實施總量管制
工研院攜手生命勵 無障礙車騎進科技殿堂
Aperia 商場推出新餐飲翼館，提升無障礙設施並打造活潑社區空間
合作夥伴為博覽會帶來無障礙環境
日本身心障礙福利服務機構的破產
